rules: One paid entry per participant. Entries are personal and can't be shared.
Enter individually or in a team of up to three. You can only be in one team.
Every team member registers, pays and confirms their own place.
Team changes after approval go through DES.
privacy: DES uses these details only to run OPEN CITY 2027: to confirm your entry, contact you about the competition and report totals to sponsors. They are not sold or shared with judges. Email us to have them corrected or deleted.

landing._note: Wording for the public OPEN CITY page (/open-city/). Dates, eligibility and prizes come from the OPEN CITY entry in events.json.
intro: OPEN CITY is the Design Student Society's flagship competition: one shared challenge facing Melbourne, taken on by students from three design disciplines over the summer break.
Enter on your own or in a team of up to three. The best work is shown at the final exhibition in March 2027.
landing.locked: The full brief and each category's challenge are for entrants only. They unlock in your participant area as soon as your entry is paid.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.text: Sign in with your email and fill in a two-minute form: name, university, category, Discord.

steps.title: Pay your entry
steps.text: Every participant needs their own paid entry. You can buy up to three at once and say who each is for.

steps.title: Unlock the brief
steps.text: The full brief, your category challenge, the rules and the Discord open up as soon as payment is confirmed.

steps.title: Solo or team
steps.text: Enter alone, register your team of two or three, or find teammates in the Discord team-finder and join later.

steps.title: Design and submit
steps.text: Round 1 submissions close 29 January 2027. Judging is anonymous: your work carries a code, not your name.

faq.a: No. You can enter individually, or in a team of two or three.

faq.q: I don't have teammates yet. Can I still sign up?
faq.a: Yes. Sign up and pay as “looking for teammates”, then use the team-finder forum on the DES Discord. When you've found a team, its leader invites you. You won't need to register again.

faq.q: Does one person pay for the whole team?
faq.a: Each member needs their own paid entry. One person can buy up to three entries and assign them by email, but buying together doesn't create the team: the team leader registers it and every member confirms.

faq.q: Can I be in more than one team?
faq.a: No. One entry per person, and one team per person.

faq.q: When do I see the brief?
faq.a: As soon as your payment is confirmed. It isn't published anywhere else.
